name: affiliateos
description: AffiliateOS — internal affiliate management platform for TikTok Shop (Indonesia)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:permissions && npm run build:database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @affiliateos/permissions && npm run test --workspace @affiliateos/database
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently --names web,worker --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:permissions && npm run build:database && npm run build --workspace @affiliateos/web
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run env:load && npm run generate --workspace @affiliateos/database
scripts.prisma:status: npm run env:load && npm run migrate:status --workspace @affiliateos/database
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm run env:load && npm run migrate:deploy --workspace @affiliateos/database
